title: GOOGL Stock In Focus: Waymo Recalls Thousands Of US Robotaxis Over Navigation Issue
key_facts: NHTSA announced Waymo will recall 3,871 robotaxis in the US
Software problem could cause vehicles to enter a closed freeway construction zone and keep driving at speed
Recall covers certain Fifth Generation Automated Driving Systems
Waymo will update the software free of charge to detect where it is and avoid construction zones
Stocktwits cites Reuters; Waymo's revenue sits in Alphabet's Other Bets, under 1% of revenue
quote_evidence: On Thursday, the U.S. road safety agency announced that Google's self-driving car unit Waymo will recall 3,871 robotaxis in the U.S. to fix a navigation issue.
Waymo will update the ADS (Automated Driving Systems) software to detect where the vehicle is and avoid entering construction zones, free of charge, NHTSA said.
why_it_matters_hint: A federal safety regulator has logged a recall of nearly 3,900 driverless cars over a freeway work-zone risk.
event_date: Thursday 18 Jun 2026 (per Bloomberg, WSJ, Business Insider, WIRED on Google News RSS)
notes: OLD NEWS RE-DATED: the Stocktwits page says 'Thursday' and carries no date; Google News RSS shows Bloomberg, WSJ, Business Insider and WIRED covering the same recall on 18 Jun 2026. Stocktwits itself cites Reuters. Score cut 2.
